get_app.description: Get an app's whole Flathub listing: its name, description, developer, licence, links, screenshots, its latest version and release notes, whether its publisher is verified, its age rating, and the command that installs it. An app that has left Flathub comes back saying so, with its new id when it was renamed.

releases.notes:
This new bugfix release of GIMP 3.2 brings a whole new level of stability:

- New input axis "Rotation" (a.k.a. "barrel rotation") supported in dynamics
- Bug fixes and usability improvements to recently added features and non-destructive workflows

The second bugfix release of the GIMP 3.2 series brings it to quite a stable state again as bugs reports are slowing down.

- Bug fixed where GIMP would fail to open some XCF
- When moving a floating layer or selection with a selection tool, marching ants are now disabled

description: Look up Linux apps on Flathub, the app store most Linux desktops install from. Search and browse its apps by category, developer or keyword, or by what is popular, trending, new or just updated; get an app's full listing, its download size and permissions, its install numbers and its add-ons; read Flathub's app of the day, apps of the week, overall statistics and year in review; and find the apps that were retired or renamed. Triggers start a workflow when a new app arrives on Flathub or an app publishes a new release. Every action reads public data. No account or API key required.
